messages:
maya: Heads up — canary run for v2p4-quant4 with stability_leash enabled started on 5% traffic. quick snapshot after 1.5h:

maya: metrics show p95 latency +120ms overall but longdoc slice p95 +420ms, top1 accuracy delta -1.8% on the longform benchmark, hallucination-rate x2 for that cohort. :thinking_face:

raj: @maya can you paste the cohort query and the metric window? want to see if this is concentrated or spread.

maya: cohort = intent:longform OR token_count>1024. window = 1h moving, compare to baseline v2p3.

olga: pasting short telemetry excerpt:
```
metric: p95_latency
baseline(v2p3): 320ms
canary(v2p4-q4): 440ms

metric: top1_accuracy_longform
baseline: 0.842
canary: 0.827
delta: -0.015 ( -1.5% )

metric: hallucination_rate_longform
baseline: 0.6%
canary: 1.2%
```

olga: also seeing CPU steal on the worker that served the longdocs but only 2% of requests.

sam: :eyes: sounds like an out-sized regression on longdocs. we should not advance traffic. propose rule: automatic rollback if any of:
- longform top1 delta <= -1.5% OR
- hallucination_rate_longform >= 2x baseline OR
- p95_latency_longform increase >= 25%

sam: plus keep the stability_leash behavior: start at 5% and require 12h clean window (no triggers) before stepping to 20%. if a trigger fires, immediate rollback to previous pinned version and mark for postmortem.

raj: +1 but prefer cohort-scoped fallback. i.e., only cut traffic for the affected cohort (longform) if we can isolate routing. global rollback only if multiple cohorts hit thresholds.

maya: we can do cohort-scoped scale-down for experimental route keys. but infra needs the route mapping rule. @deploy-bot can you flag the current canary with a hold state and run a rollback if threshold hits?

deploy-bot: [automated] canary flagged: v2p4-quant4-stability_leash @5% -> hold policy enabled. rollback policy: cohort-scoped if route_key in [longform], else global if >1 cohort breached.

olga: logging note — add longdoc request_id and kv-cache hit/miss to the eval slice so we can correlate hallucination with cache warmness.

maya: we'll wait another 10m and then disable step-up. if no improvement after 6h we'll rollback proactively. filing a quick follow-up ticket. :memo: 

raj: thanks — ping when you flip to 0% or if you need help with live traces.

sam: good plan. also add an eval harness run for the longform golden set in shadow to reproduce locally.

maya: noted. starting shadow eval now. will update thread with final decision. :shipit:
